original_policy: Only confirmed original-context evidence changes trigger independent concern review; unaffected scores are carried with a reason. Unknown/contradictory meanings stay null or require clarification.
conditional_policy: Require an explicit combined proposal and joint response. Score only confirmed modified-context meanings, preserving untested facets as unavailable. No reuse of original boundary anchors as post-mitigation acceptance. No automatic bonus or cap removal.

conditional_anchors.1: Explicit categorical rejection of this facet even in the stated modified proposal.
conditional_anchors.2: Strong remaining boundary, minimal tolerance under this proposal.
conditional_anchors.3: Strong remaining disruption or objection requiring further substantial change.
conditional_anchors.4: Substantial remaining reservation; further conditions still required.
conditional_anchors.5: Expressed balanced acceptance and reservations; unsure without a position is null.
conditional_anchors.6: Cautious acceptance of this modified proposal with remaining reservations.
conditional_anchors.7: Qualified acceptance with manageable remaining conditions.
conditional_anchors.8: Clear acceptance of this facet in this modified proposal.
conditional_anchors.9: Explicit unqualified endorsement of this facet in this modified proposal.

aggregation: Each profile independently uses scoring.json, assessed-only mean, minimum coverage, phase-1 threshold/cap, half-up rounding. Coverage differences are not personal improvement or decline.

combined_changes.q1: Navigation cameras use the hypothetical Lens-Shielding Hardware Shroud: only direct forward viewing, with no downward viewing into private yards/windows. Telemetry and cybersecurity arrangements remain unspecified.
combined_changes.q2: The residential route operates at120 meters instead of60 meters, with no flights between19:00 and07:00. Assume the sound profile is below ambient city street noise. Frequency remains up to15 flights/day. Altitude, sound and curfew are a bundle, not independently tested changes.

evidence_projection: Original assessment preserves distinct aspect meanings: uncertainty stays recorded separately from clear established aspects. Conditional assessment requires every genuinely evidenced current aspect; superseded testimony and question-only nominations cannot create requirements. Joint acceptance links declared tested aspects; explicit applicability confirmation links an unchanged established meaning, with independent numeric re-review rather than numeric inheritance.
